purpose: Public-safe operating queue for manual, recipient-specific outreach around the Homeground China ten-city arrival, stay and departure map.

limitations: Original schematic and editorial matrix, not a navigational map.
Not a live timetable, fare, operating-status or entry-policy service.
Dynamic facts must be confirmed with the relevant operator or authority.

guardrails.senderRule: While homegroundchina.com mail authentication is unverified, use only an existing operator-controlled real-name mailbox; do not impersonate a domain mailbox.

statusDefinitions.monitor: A prior contact may exist; Gmail Sent must be checked and a second first-touch is forbidden.
statusDefinitions.ready-after-live: Recipient and angle are usable only after the production asset, ZIP and licence pass live verification and Gmail Sent is clear.
statusDefinitions.needs-one-item: Exactly one named prerequisite must be completed before promotion to ready-after-live.
statusDefinitions.hold: Do not send with the current asset and angle; re-review only after the named trigger exists.
